title: Big move before IPO: NSE to launch Nifty India FPI 150 Futures & Options from August 12
summary: The NSE has received SEBI approval to launch futures and options on the Nifty India FPI 150 Index from August 12, enhancing its index derivative offerings for investor hedging and diversification with a focus on liquidity.
